mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tax whose structure is such that the revenue yield becomes smaller as the value of the property taxed increases. (Ayua: 1996: 2)."
Regressive tax is a tax whose structure is such that the revenue yield becomes smaller as the value of the property taxed increases. (Ayua: 1996: 2).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the levying of tax on the same items by different tax authorities."
Double taxation is the levying of tax on the same items by different tax authorities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the ways to make take system effective in an economy."
Tax incentives are one of the ways to make take system effective in an economy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of evaluating the activities whether they are positive or negative of any object."
Attitude is a means of evaluating the activities whether they are positive or negative of any object.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the estimate of the annual cost of using an item that is based on its acquisition cost divided by its estimated or assumed useful life."
Depreciation allowance refers to the estimate of the annual cost of using an item that is based on its acquisition cost divided by its estimated or assumed useful life.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the situation where the tax incentives result in too much investment in a certain area of the economy and too little investment in other areas of the economy."

Compliance costs Compliance cost refers to the situation where the tax incentives result in too much investment in a certain area of the economy and too little investment in other areas of the economy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those allowed to an individual tax payer which are set off against his gross income in order to ascertain his taxable income, that is, the amount of income on which tax is to be charged."

Personal relief are those allowed to an individual tax payer which are set off against his gross income in order to ascertain his taxable income, that is, the amount of income on which tax is to be charged.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tax system that takes an increasing proportion as income rises. (M.T."
Progressive tax is a tax system that takes an increasing proportion as income rises. (M.T.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a pecuniary burden laid upon individual or property to support government expenditure."
A tax is a pecuniary burden laid upon individual or property to support government expenditure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the power and authority by a tier of government to impose and collect taxes from the citizenry in that particular state."
Taxing power is the power and authority by a tier of government to impose and collect taxes from the citizenry in that particular state.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non-economic factor that determines the success of a tax system in tax (Alkhatib et al., 2019)."
Tax fairness/equity Tax fairness is a non-economic factor that determines the success of a tax system in tax (Alkhatib et al., 2019).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a theory whereby tax classification is based on the percentage or amount of income of the tax payer."
Income theory is a theory whereby tax classification is based on the percentage or amount of income of the tax payer.
fib: ______ is defined by the Excise Ordinance No. 64 of 1941 as "any duty other than export duty of customs imposed on any goods manufactured in Nigeria".
Excise duty
Excise duty is defined by the Excise Ordinance No. 64 of 1941 as "any duty other than export duty of customs imposed on any goods manufactured in Nigeria".
______ is a tax you pay on things that you buy especially those that you bring into a country (Hornby: 2000:364).
duty
A duty is a tax you pay on things that you buy especially those that you bring into a country (Hornby: 2000:364).
______ are one of the oldest taxes (M.T Abdulrazaq).
Stamp duties
Stamp duties are one of the oldest taxes (M.T Abdulrazaq).
______ is the problem of tax avoidance and tax evasion.
major taxation problem in Nigeria
The major taxation problem in Nigeria is the problem of tax avoidance and tax evasion.
______ is the ability or power of any government to levy tax or raise revenue through taxation.
power to tax
A power to tax is the ability or power of any government to levy tax or raise revenue through taxation.
______ means a period of exemption from the payment of taxes imposed by the government and this exemption may be complete or partial. (Ayua I.A:1996:306).
Tax exemption simply
Tax exemption simply means a period of exemption from the payment of taxes imposed by the government and this exemption may be complete or partial. (Ayua I.A:1996:306).
______ refers to lost government tax revenue as a result of the tax incentive.
Resource allocation
Resource allocation costs Resource allocation refers to lost government tax revenue as a result of the tax incentive.
______ is the tax that is paid by each tax payers premised on the same ratio to the amount to be raised as the value of his property bears to the total taxable income.
Proportional tax
Proportional tax is the tax that is paid by each tax payers premised on the same ratio to the amount to be raised as the value of his property bears to the total taxable income.
______ is a method applied in allocation of the cost of tangible assets or fixed assets over an assets' useful life.
Depreciation
Depreciation is a method applied in allocation of the cost of tangible assets or fixed assets over an assets' useful life.
______ is one of the difficulty aspects of the tax man's work because once the income is known the correct assessment is an easy task.
Finding of income
Finding of income is one of the difficulty aspects of the tax man's work because once the income is known the correct assessment is an easy task.
______ is the 25th items on the Exclusive Legislative List.
export duty
An export duty is the 25th items on the Exclusive Legislative List.
